rationale: Đường thẳng vuông góc với mặt phẳng phân biệt (two distinct lines perpendicular to a plane are parallel) and Tính chất đường thẳng vuông góc với mặt phẳng (line perpendicular to two intersecting lines in a plane is perpendicular to the plane) are different theorems/properties about perpendicularity; they are not identical.
